$comment: Ratchet baselines. Each entry is a violation count that is allowed to shrink and never to grow.
GATE-TOPOLOGY.md §2.3a: these instruments have never run on this repository, so their first run
produces findings in the hundreds. Paying them down as a precondition would stall issue #2 behind
unrelated work; running them non-blocking would make them annotation, which is level 5 with a
config file on. So they block on INCREASE from the day they land.
An unknown key is a failure, not a pass. A linter that appears in a run but not here means the
enabled set moved without the baseline moving with it, and the gate must not treat that as zero.
When a count drops, commit the lower number in the same PR that dropped it. A baseline left above
the truth is headroom for a regression nobody will see.
